curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What begins as an unexplained absence soon turns into a high-stakes search for the hidden truth behind a soldier's return home.
curatedMovie.description: When their son goes missing shortly after returning from a tour of duty in Iraq, a career military officer and his wife partner with a local police detective to uncover what happened.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, emotionally weighty mystery that demands engaged focus as a painful inquiry unfolds.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Paul Haggis, this somber mystery blends military drama with a measured procedural, delivering a tense and emotionally heavy search for answers.
